newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Wednesday's settlement day amid selling pressure from short-term investors, dealers said.
The Karachi bourse 100-share index ended 13.68 points, or 0.89 percent, lower at 1,519.19 amid 197 losers and 57 gainers.

Position-squaring on the settlement day triggered the selling pressure, one dealer said. PTCL fell 1.75 rupees to 24.85 on the transaction of 9.4 million shares, the dealer said. Dewan Salman fell 1.25 to 34.70 and ICI Pakistan 0.55 to 22.25. Century Insurance rose 3.00 to 24.
